name: Nvidium Frontier Default
description: Physically-based mesh-shader deferred pipeline featuring per-block material shading, 3-cascade sun/moon shadows, Horizon GTAO, volumetric light shafts & clouds, Gerstner water with caustics & SSR, dynamic handheld lighting, rain puddles, TAA, and AgX/ACES tonemapping.
author: Nvidium Team

options.name: Sunlight Intensity
options.description: Direct sun and moon directional illuminance multiplier

options.name: Sky Ambient Intensity
options.description: Hemispherical sky and indirect ground-bounce ambient brightness

options.name: Emissive Block Glow
options.description: HDR luminance multiplier for torches, lanterns, lava, glowstone, sculk, and glowing ores

options.name: Handheld Dynamic Light
options.description: Casts colored point light from held torches, soul lanterns, lava buckets, and glowing items

options.name: Cloud Coverage
options.description: Fraction of sky covered by dynamic clouds (automatically increases during rain)

options.name: Volumetric Godrays
options.description: Intensity of raymarched crepuscular sun/moon light shafts

options.name: Atmospheric Haziness
options.description: Controls aerial perspective and Mie forward scattering haze

options.name: Water Wave Amplitude
options.description: Gerstner surface wave height and normal perturbation strength

options.name: Water Clarity
options.description: Controls underwater Beer-Lambert absorption depth and clarity

options.name: Underwater Caustics
options.description: Animated refractive light patterns projected onto underwater seabed surfaces

options.name: Rain Wetness & Puddles
options.description: Dynamic reflective puddles and porous darkening on outdoor surfaces during rain

options.name: Subsurface Scattering
options.description: Transmitted sunlight wrap and translucency through foliage, leaves, ice, and snow

options.name: Surface Relief / Bump
options.description: Strength of LabPBR and micro-surface relief normal mapping

options.name: Foliage Wind Speed
options.description: Speed and amplitude of waving grass, crops, vines, and leaves

options.name: Shadow Penumbra Softness
options.description: Vogel-disk PCF filter radius for sun and moon shadows
